::: handwriting
Mrs Kessler,

At eight I locked the tower stairs with my own padlock. Nobody climbs to {{place:clock-room}} alone today.

You saw his plan in the van bin strips. He means to push that thing into the wheels at 15:17, and then the four o'clock whistle never blows.
:::

::: handwriting
Mr Platt reads my notes, so I never write the code down.
:::

::: handwriting
The code of the padlock is the time when R. left the set on Night 2, read as one four-digit number, plus (the millions of viewers that Crown wants, times the steps up to the clock room).

First do the multiplication in the brackets, then add the time.
:::

::: handwriting
Open the door before ten past three. Keep Mr Platt at the bottom.

F. O.
:::

::: pagebreak
:::

{{artifact}}

::: small
Four dials. Turn them to the code, from left to right.
:::
